researchId.title: Research ID
researchId.description: Deep research job id (research_id) returned from create/run flows. Allowed workflow values for orchestration: SHOW_THINKING, RUN_RESEARCH, EDIT_PLAN (see deepResearchWorkflowAction on the topic).

knowledgeSpaceId.title: Knowledge Space ID
knowledgeSpaceId.description: Notebook AI knowledge space id for context

deepResearchWorkflowAction.title: Deep Research Workflow Action
deepResearchWorkflowAction.description: Must be SHOW_THINKING for this action. Other values: RUN_RESEARCH and EDIT_PLAN are handled by other invocable actions in the Deep Research topic.
